en: A Text for Chanting on the Meaning of the Name of the Dharma, Submitted in Humility:
I have been separated from my regular sleep and meals, lying ill for some time. In the morning, the breeze blows against the curtains;

in the evening, clouds of sorrow gather at the edge of the courtyard. Beneath the bedchamber curtains, where the *yuanyuan* and *luanluan* birds once sang in harmony, a look of grief now lurks in silence.
Life. Between the emerald eaves, a vast and hazy mist rises in chaotic swirls.
My illness has healed; my mind is clear. You, Master Qian, are a gentleman of integrity and a brilliant talent of Luo.
Constantly harboring a heart of the three meanings, he always possessed the beauty of "cutting through gold.
Suddenly, due to the jade-like essence being moved by the patterns of glass,
his body grew emaciated like a flower of snow in the sixth month.
My appearance has withered like the leaves of the ninth autumn;

I have thus looked up in reliance upon the Imperial Enlightenment, reverently receiving his "green eyes" of favor, and having opened my heart to the Golden Father, I am blessed by the far-reaching illumination of his compassionate white hair. I rejoice at this attainment.
The six sense faculties are pure and tranquil, like the moon shining upon an autumn river;
the clouds of the three obstructions have dissipated, resembling red lotuses blooming in a verdant pond.
This is because one’s faith is sincere and unclouded.
The divine discernment is manifest and brilliant:
as the clouds of compassion spread, the feverish afflictions are cooled;
as the shadow of grace descends, chronic ailments subside and cease.
Having already received the protection and mindfulness of all Buddhas,
how could one not feel a heart of celebration?
To express this on this morning, I shall employ the adornments of a woman of festivity to perform praise and celebration.
I humbly pray that the azure mountains may accompany your longevity and the crimson trees may flourish with spring.
May you surely achieve the attainment of engraved jade and display the celebration of the Milky Way.
I further pray that the lotus flower shall blossom within the ocean of your nature.
The bright moon shines upon the terrace of the heart;

may you forever dwell in the years of verdant youth and remain eternally confined within curtains of lotus blossoms. We humbly pray that your dark tresses shall never change and your crimson powder increase with the spring.
May your virtue match the pines beneath the crags, and your longevity equal the cassia in the moon.
I humbly pray that your green eyebrows, shaped like the crescent moon, shall long retain the brilliance of the eight characters;

that your jade-like countenance, as fresh as spring, shall alone possess the splendor of the season. O Illustrious Gentleman, I humbly pray that your literary talent shall cause the five-colored brush to dance.
Looking loftily upon the great current, he realized he had mastered the nine classics;
looking down upon Bao Zhao and Xie Lingyun,
he broke the celestial cassia branch of the Eastern Hall.
From his youth, he mastered the refined melodies of Confucian scholars;
his fame spread throughout the realm, and his brothers shone like the petals of a flower.
Like jade trees and lotus blossoms, they shared the same refinement as their father moved through the court.
The daughter beneath the knees of Changguang is adorned with dignity; the pines and mulberries grow ever more verdant, their phoenix-like plumage forming long, curling patterns in the courtyard.

The jade lotuses are luxuriantly fragrant, and the immortal cassias remain perpetually flourishing. May the Lady’s vast ocean-like virtue flow eternally, sustaining auspicious blessings that extend ever further.
His life-span is as lofty as Mount Shou, rising higher than the multitude of peaks; his martial majesty is like a golden seal, forever adorned with purple ribbons and enjoying eternal glory.
His wealth fills the treasures of the four seas, and his blessings are inexhaustible.
The emolument of the Five Marquises brings clarity and auspiciousness;
honor and fortune renew daily, and what is planned shall endure long.
Thus, in all movements and stillness, there is eternal peace and supreme good fortune. May this be known by my late father.
The North will surely bring about the North;
one ought to fan the pillow and celebrate the attainment of warmth and clarity.
Who would have expected that suddenly the waves would overturn and capsize the boat, and in an instant, the wind from the courtyard would extinguish the candle?
This orphaned son contemplates the ethereal breaths of the netherworld;
exhausting his thoughts while at my parents' side only serves to increase my grief.
I have yet to fulfill my sincere intention of offering them oranges.
In vain he clung to the meaning of the transmission of the robe;
his thoughts on the filial way of establishing one's character were cut short by the earth.
In grief, he beheld the winds blowing incessantly through the trees of mourning.
I grieve that the Cold Spring is forever separated from you; you have passed away, leaving behind your majestic splendor.

I prostrate myself with the hope that within the Vaiḍūrya Palace, you shall pace back and forth upon the fragrant terraces, and amidst the groves of precious trees, pluck celestial flowers to offer [to the Buddha]. Furthermore, may you receive the prophecy at the Azure Pond and be reborn by transformation within the red lotus.
May the water of the Dharma moisten the mind and the fragrant breeze stir the consciousness. I humbly pray that by the side of the Terrace of Nectar, you may hear the sound of Prajñā;

in the Forest of Liberation, may you joyfully appear at the assembly of the Dragon-Flower. I humbly pray that with the five clouds supporting your feet, you may roam freely and return to the Palace of Liberation.
Sustained by the spiritual power of a hundred blessings, he is liberated from the suffering of the bonds of craving.
Boys under ten years of age have faces as radiant as blooming lotuses;
their fragrant countenances may seem to wither, yet his face remains as upright and serene as the autumn moon.
Of such rare and exquisite beauty, she was like a fine silken robe;
the neighborhood gazed upon her with admiration for the excellence of her family’s tradition, while the streets sighed at the rarity of her presence.
Her vital spirit was on the verge of manifesting, yet it suddenly vanished.
The flowers were in full bloom when they suddenly fell;

this caused the stern father to wail for his compassionate son with enduring grief. The petals and lotus branches grieve for the vast emptiness of the geese' flight; the evening clouds are heavy, and the maiden’s majestic form is solemn.
By nature she was as serene as the bright moon and her essence as pure as autumn frost.
Her youthful form possessed the graceful elegance of the Southern Kingdoms,
and her deportment rivaled the exquisite beauty of Xi Shi.

Originally, I hoped for the glory of the family gate; may these fragments of light further honor the clan. May the four virtues transmit their fragrance to bring splendor to the nine branches of kinship. Alas, the Yellow Heaven does not grant its protection; my plans have suddenly come to an end.
The lotus flowers droop as the moonlight on the cassia tree fades away.
The fragrant trees wither and the graceful form of the orchid ceases its rich scent;
one reflects on how Chang’e fled to the lunar palace for all eternity,
sighing over the wandering waters that flow back to the sea without returning— how sorrowful!
His parents’ profound sorrow gave rise to the desire for a matrimonial alliance; his writings extol virtue.
His capacity is vast, expansive, and deep; he honors and admires ritual and music.
His aspirations transcend the present and the past; his every movement accords with the divine spirit.
His spirit towers like the clouds over Mount Yulei;
his capacity for benevolence is as vast as the waters of the Cangxuan Sea. His martial virtue evokes sighs of admiration;
he was born with the nature of wind and cloud, and his character was formed by the patterns of the stars.
Established in faith and abiding in righteousness, his benevolence was profound and his virtue weighty.
Wielding both civil and martial arts, he was a preeminent talent of the Purple Palace;
exhausting himself in loyalty and integrity, he became the heart and core of one who is selfless.
Were it not so, how could he have been esteemed within the military capital, held in high office, and his reputation resound through the human world with a fragrance that perfumes the city?
We, the Secretaries of the Ministry of Rites, humbly pray that the light of his virtue may shine upon the Golden Tablets, serving as the very limbs of the world.

May his voice resound upon the jade steps, and his illustrious fame be manifest beneath the sun; furthermore, may the waters of Prajñā wisdom irrigate the field of the body, and the fragrant breeze of Candana nourish the ocean of the nature.
Illustrious fame shall be firmly established, and the position of Paul shall be exalted;
his golden and purple robes shall vie in brilliance with the sun and moon, and his blessings and longevity shall endure as eternally firm as the mountains and rivers. (Recitation for Women)
Upon the high terrace, the precious mirror reflects a countenance that transcends all ages, as clouds approach it;
like laughing suns and jade flowers, the mist adorns the beauty of the Southern Kingdom.
Thus one knows that the solemn purity of such merit and virtue is entrusted to the power of the Buddha to remain hidden.
By offering the aforementioned "name-clothes" (*nāmakāṣāya*), I manifest my sincere devotion;
having entered the Nalanda Garden, I bow my head before the Golden Man and assemble with the monastics of the sevenfold eloquence.
Manifesting the transformation-buddhas of a thousand bodies,
one may thus cultivate through kalpas of accumulated dust and thus transcend the heat of affliction.
As this deep aspiration has been made this very morning,
may the merit within my heart surely benefit your noble person.
I humbly pray that the nectar of the various devas will descend in response to these earnest entreaties and remain close at hand.
The Great Sage bestowed his majestic power, pouring the essence of *amṛta* (tī-mí-hú) into the crown of [the practitioner's] head;

thus, the accumulated karmic burdens of many lifetimes were brought to rest through the power of mindfulness, and the transgressions and faults of the present life were utterly extinguished by means of this extraordinary cause.
June, the seventh year of the Yuanhe era of the Great Tang; verified again during a moment of conversation.
